title: Lenovo’s Legion Go S with SteamOS is down to its lowest price ever
summary: Lenovo's Legion Go S handheld gaming console with SteamOS is now at its lowest-ever price of $635.54 with promo code EXTRASAVEAFF, down from $1,137.41. The Z2 Go processor delivers solid indie gaming performance and can handle demanding titles at reduced settings. The 8-inch 120Hz IPS display with variable refresh rate differentiates it from competitors at the same price point.
content:
Lenovo’s Legion Go S with SteamOS. | Photo by Sean Hollister / The Verge	

Memory and storage prices will be inflated for the foreseeable future, so we’re always happy to find a good deal on capable gaming hardware, like this discount on the Lenovo Legion Go S with a Z2 Go processor and SteamOS. Normally $1,137.41 (and selling for close to $1,000 at Best Buy), Lenovo has the handheld console on sale for just $635.54 when you use code EXTRASAVEAFF at checkout, the lowest price we’ve seen yet for this model.
Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS (Z2 Go)

Where to Buy:

 $1137.41 $635.54 at Lenovo (w/ code EXTRASAVEAFF)

We reviewed both the Windows and SteamOS versions of this gaming handheld when it released in 2024, and found the latter to be a much more appealing option, largely thanks to the improved user experience that Windows has shown signs that it’s slowly catching up to. The Z2 Go chip isn’t all that impressive, with similar performance to the more expensive OLED Steam Deck, but it’s still a solid choice for indie games and more spec-intensive titles if you turn the settings down. The 8-inch IPS panel goes up to 120Hz, and has variable refresh rate, which helps the Legion Go S stand out among other options at the same price.
Read our Lenovo Legion Go S (SteamOS) review.

That's exactly what's happening to many BMW owners, however, who are being shown banner ads for Spider-man: Brand New Day on their Control Display upon starting the vehicle.
In a statement to The Autopian, BMW confirmed that the ads are definitely real, serving as part of "a broader brand partnership" with the new Marvel movie. BMW's own announcement also confirms that the ads are running from July 27th until August 10th, and reveals how widespread they are:

The exploit undermines hardware wallets' reputation for robust security protections. The incident raises significant concerns about the safety of supposedly secure cryptocurrency storage solutions.
content: A security vulnerability in the cryptocurrency hardware wallet Coldcard is allowing hackers to drain the crypto from victims’ wallets. The total losses amount to more than $130 million, according to blockchain-monitoring firms.

title: Tom DeLay helped create TV ownership cap—he says Trump FCC has no authority to repeal it
summary: Former congressman Tom DeLay, who helped establish Congress's 39% television ownership cap, argues the FCC lacks authority to repeal the rule. The dispute centers on whether the regulatory body can unilaterally overturn a congressionally-established ownership limit. DeLay's position opposes the Trump administration FCC's stated intention to eliminate the cap.
content: Congress set ownership limit at 39%, but FCC claims authority to kill the rule.

title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
summary: Spotify secured backing from Merlin, representing over 30,000 independent labels, for its AI remix and covers product alongside Universal Music Group. The paid tool allows fans to create AI-generated covers and remixes while guaranteeing artist compensation and credit. The partnerships demonstrate music industry stakeholders embracing controlled AI generation with proper artist protections.
content: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.

title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
summary: Texas halted new data center construction as the governor calls for audits, citing concerns about power supply and regulatory capacity. The pause comes after Texas attracted numerous tech companies with loose regulations and abundant energy resources. The move reflects growing tensions between rapid AI infrastructure expansion and physical infrastructure constraints.
content: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply. But even Texas can be pushed to the brink.

content:
The next Xbox, Project Helix, could theoretically have the largest library of any home console. Not only will it play PC games, but we now know, courtesy of a leaked memo obtained by The Verge's Tom Warren, that it will run games from every generation of Xbox: the original 2001 Xbox, the 2005 Xbox 360, the 2013 Xbox One, and the 2020 Xbox Series, as well as any new Helix titles.
We already knew that Microsoft was bringing a limited sample of original Xbox games to PC, and we already knew it was prepping a way to digitize your Xbox One and Xbox Series discs. The leak fills in the missing puzzle pieces.

zh.title: 下一代Xbox可能支持运行所有Xbox游戏
zh.summary: 一份泄露的备忘录显示,微软的Project Helix主机将支持所有Xbox代系的向后兼容性——从2001年的初代Xbox到Xbox Series——以及PC游戏和新游戏。这项创新将让下一代Xbox拥有任何家用主机中最大的游戏库。

title: Can Reddit fend off a new wave of AI SEO spam?
summary: Reddit faces a surge of AI-generated SEO spam disguised as authentic user comments, with bot accounts promoting products through seemingly genuine reviews. The trend challenges Reddit's community authenticity and raises questions about the platform's ability to combat automated manipulation.
content:
Earlier this year, a Reddit user had asked members of a skincare-focused subreddit if anyone had tried a specific hypochlorous acid spray, a product often used for acne. There were dozens of responses; one from a user named Primary-Taro4254 seemed innocuous enough, at least at first.
"I haven't personally tried [that brand] so I can't fully compare, sorry," they commented. "But I have been using a similar hypochlorous acid spray from Honeydew Labs and I've honestly really liked it." 
Primary-Taro4254 helpfully shared their experience using the spray to calm their skin's redness and irritation, and even threw in some of Honeydew Labs' crede …

zh.title: Reddit能否抵挡新一波AI SEO垃圾信息?
zh.summary: Reddit正面临AI生成的SEO垃圾信息激增,这些垃圾信息伪装成真实用户评论,机器人账户通过看似真实的评价推广产品。这一趋势挑战了Reddit社区的真实性,并引发了人们对该平台防止自动化操纵能力的疑问。

title: The studio behind Pokémon struggles to find its voice in Beast of Reincarnation
summary: Game Freak ventures beyond its Pokémon franchise with Beast of Reincarnation, an action game intended to showcase the studio's creative potential. However, the game lacks the innovative ideas needed to stand out in the crowded action genre. The project represents an ambitious attempt to break from the pocket monster series but ultimately falls short in execution.
content:
You have to imagine that the team at Game Freak is bursting with ideas. The studio puts out new mainline Pokémon adventures with a machinelike precision. But every so often it launches a curious experiment, whether it's an action title about a militarized elephant or turning horse races into a card game, showing that it's capable of more than the latest generation of pocket monsters. That's part of what makes the idea of Beast of Reincarnation so enticing.
